segments.text: Moha Pradesh Samhatastu karmatma. On the contrary, the yogi, whose god-consciousness is destroyed by this illusion, by this state of illusion.
His karmatma, he is dependent to his actions. So, his karmas, his actions, past, present and future will lead him, will play him.
So, he is ordinary individual. He is no good yogi. The one whose state of being is destroyed by this illusion.
By this illusion of duality, that this is pain, not good, this is pleasure, good, better.
You have got a good job. Nice, congratulations. I am dismissed. Oh, we said.
This is the state of karmatma. This is the state of individual being.
Mohaena, agganena. Moha means aggana. Ignorance.
By ignorance, who is Pradesh Samhatastu? Pradesh Samhatastu means Tatyika Gana, who is shang with this moha, this illusion.
Tatyavasukudukhashavaya. So, it is why he has become the object of pain and pleasure. He has become object of pain and pleasure.
Plain thing of object. Plain thing of pain and pleasure. Pain and pleasure play him. He is not the player of pain and pleasure as yogi was.
He is played by pain and pleasure. So, he is karmatma. He is karmatma. He is said to be karmatma.
His environment of Surupa is only action. He is dependent upon action. Actions will carry him.
So, he is karmatma. He is always blotted by good and bad actions.
Tatyavasukudukhashavaya. He is said in that very shastra, Kalika Krama.
Yet, avidyaavaratayya, recalupa vidiyoga ta shivaadin naivujatati samudbhava ye dekhilaand.
Tatyavasubhava, laksantita, dosatta, ashibe vestibhava ye de param dukham prajahite.
Yet, avidyaavaratayya, one, this yogi does not maintain awareness of God consciousness.
But, on the contrary, he is covered. His God consciousness is covered by ignorance. Avidyaavaratayya, recalupa vidiyoga ta shivaadin naivujatati samudbhava ye dekhilaand.
He does not experience all the elementary state of universe beginning from Shiva to ending in earth.
All these 36 elements does not experience in the way of Supremeity, in the way of universal universality.
Then only Shiva, Shiva, Bhava, Laksantita, then only the states of good and bad appear to him.
And by that, by experiencing that good and bad things, ashibe vestibhava ye de param dukham prajahite.
So, this supreme pain shines in him, because of those states which are not fortunate.
Absolutely, he becomes unfortunate being, but we will do this.
